summary: AVAI BIO, INC. filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of its Joint Venture and License Agreement with Ainnova Tech Inc., originally dated November 8, 2024 (effective November 11, 2024). Under that agreement, the parties had formed Ai-Nova Acquisition Corp. (AAC) to develop AI-based healthcare technologies. The Termination Agreement cancels all obligations and liabilities, with no termination penalties or further financial obligations. AAC will be formally dissolved. Both parties will cooperate on an orderly wind-down. No consideration, premium, or break fee is involved. Watch for any residual disputes or asset transfers between AVAI and Ainnova.
